`abstract class SwitchNode<V>`<br/>
**Extends:** [`BaseChoiceNode<V>`](/reference/controls/basechoicenode/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.impl.control.choice` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [SwitchNode.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/impl/control/choice/SwitchNode.java)

A choice that shows every option side by side, one node per option, and selects the option under a left press.

![A switch with three states, Two selected in blue; the pointer selects Three, One, then Two](/captures/catalog-controls-switchnode.webp)

## Description

A skin extends it and gives `option((value, index) -> node)`, which creates the node of each option.
The switch splits its width equally between the options, in their order.
Attaching a switch without an `option` function throws an `IllegalStateException`.

## Creation details

<a id="SwitchNode-constructor"></a>

### SwitchNode

`SwitchNode(double x, double y, double width, double height)` <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Creates the switch at `x`, `y` with a `width` and a `height` in design pixels, from the constructor of a skin.

## Property details

<a id="SwitchNode-property-option"></a>

### option

- `this option(BiFunction<V,Integer,Node> option)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

**Default:** 

The function that creates the node of an option from its value and its index.
The switch calls it again for every option each time the options change.

## Method details

<a id="SwitchNode-method-getOptionList"></a>

### getOptionList

`List<Node> getOptionList()` 

Returns the nodes of the options, in the order of the options, as a read-only list.

<a id="SwitchNode-method-layout"></a>

### layout

`void layout()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span>

Places the nodes of the options side by side, each one as wide as the switch divided by the number of options.

<a id="SwitchNode-method-mousePressed"></a>

### mousePressed

`void mousePressed(NodeMouseEvent<?> event)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span>

Selects the option under a left press that no one consumed, through `change(...)`, and consumes the press.

<a id="SwitchNode-method-createOptions"></a>

### createOptions

`void createOptions()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Removes the nodes of the previous options and creates one node per option with the `option` function.
